differs.layout: One large document fills the right half beside a big heading, instead of a belt of small cards through three stations with an audit trail.
differs.data: One payment at a time with its amount at display size, instead of a queue of eight with a held exception and a running log.
differs.moment: The press slams down and leaves a rotated, speckled APPROVED impression on the paper, close up; the parent is remembered for the belt indexing between stations.

blurb: One payment close up: its checks tick, a press slams APPROVED onto it, it is signed and sealed, then the next rises from the pile.
